papers.title: From Packets to Defense: Architectural Patterns in eBPF-Based Intrusion Detection
papers.summary: 扩展伯克利包过滤器（eBPF）已成为现代 Linux 系统中支持安全、低时延包处理的变革性内核可编程框架。通过验证字节码执行，eBPF 提供此前用户态工具无法企及的细粒度内核可观测性与强制能力，推动其在网络入侵检测与防御中广泛采用。研究首次给出基于 eBPF 的入侵检测系统结构化分类法，系统梳理学术研究与生产框架，按 hook 点、数据源、响应机制等维度组织系统为三类，涉及 eBPF、XDP、SmartNIC offload。读者关注点在于分类法对 XDP/TC/tracepoint hook 与 SmartNIC offload 路径的覆盖边界及对生产部署选型的指导。
papers.summary_en: The extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) has emerged as a transformative in-kernel programmable framework enabling secure, low-latency packet processing in modern Linux systems. By supporting verified bytecode execution, eBPF provides fine-grained kernel observability and enforcement previously inaccessible to userspace tools, driving widespread adoption in network intrusion detection and prevention.This paper presents the first structured taxonomy of eBPF-based intrusion detection systems, systematically categorizing academic research and production frameworks. papers.title: Performance Comparison of Modern CNI Technologies for Microservice Architectures
papers.summary: 容器微服务架构中用于互联的底层网络技术是影响应用性能的关键组件。研究对三种依赖不同网络方案的流行容器网络接口（CNI）做综合性能评估——Flannel（标准 Linux 网络栈与工具）、Antrea（Open vSwitch）、Cilium（eBPF）——覆盖多种微服务拓扑。研究开发了微服务拓扑生成器以创建简单链路与有向无环图（DAG）拓扑，涉及 eBPF、网络优化、容器网络与性能。读者关注点在于 Cilium（eBPF 数据路径）相对 Flannel/OVS 在吞吐与时延上的实测差距，及拓扑复杂度对结果的影响。
papers.summary_en: The underlying networking technologies used for interconnection in container-based microservice architectures are critical components as they directly impact the application performance. This paper presents a comprehensive performance evaluation of three popular Container Network Interface (CNI) relying on different networking solutions —Flannel (standard Linux networking stack and tools), Antrea (Open vSwitch), and Cilium (eBPF)— across varying microservice topologies.
